stories.h: Edmonds fun center site to become 411 apartments
stories.s: Developers secured nearly $132 million to replace the vacant Edmonds Family Fun Center off Highway 99 with two eight-story buildings. Demolition is expected to start next week; opening targeted August 2029.

stories.h: Local groups prepare for Medicaid, SNAP cuts
stories.s: Over 100 Snohomish County service providers met in Lynnwood on federal cuts; Medicaid work requirements begin Jan. 1, 2027, and SNAP exemptions have narrowed. Healthplanfinder open enrollment runs through Jan. 15.

stories.h: Marysville passes $470M budget with steep utility hikes
stories.s: The council unanimously approved the 2027-28 budget with no property tax increase, a sales tax rise to 9.5%, and higher utility rates, including water jumping from $59.58 to $95.32 per 10,000 gallons.

stories.h: Stronger, windier storm due Saturday night into Sunday
stories.s: After rain arrives late Friday into Saturday, a stronger system brings blustery winds Saturday night into Sunday, especially from Everett northward. Clear leaf-clogged storm drains; major flooding isn't expected.

stories.h: Repeat boat theft suspect prompts Everett Marina warning
stories.s: A 21-year-old Everett man has been arrested three times since Oct. 14 for alleged boat thefts and illegal crabbing. Police urge owners to check stored boats and remove valuables and kicker motors this winter.

coming.h: Skate America weekend sessions in Everett
coming.s: Grand Prix event at Angel of the Winds Arena continues Saturday (11:15 a.m. and 7 p.m.) and Sunday (11 a.m.) after Friday night's opening session.

coming.h: WSU men's basketball plays Hawaii in Everett
coming.s: Washington State faces Hawaii at 7 p.m. Wednesday at Angel of the Winds Arena.
